svg.title: Look at the whole HVAC system
svg.desc: Isometric cutaway of a ceiling void showing a fan coil unit with a blocked condensate tray, the supply duct, the return plenum, flexible duct runs to grilles, and six numbered inspection points.
svg.text: Look at the whole HVAC system
Isolate, protect, refer: system off and tagged, grilles sealed. Restart only after a qualified sign-off.
CARSI · Level 3 Mould Remediation · schematic, not to scale
